Automap redesign: reference mockup (2026-11-01)

The agreed automap redesign of 2026-11-01 (design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-01-automap-look-and-controls-design.md, local only), drawn from a real export of all 14 levels of a DM save, with the game's own pictures. "Now" approximates the map before the redesign. Spoilers All everywhere: the real map keeps to what the party knows.
Try: L10 (12,22): hidden switch with 14 targets · L10 (14,24), (16,24): pads that need Diamond Edge carried · L10 (23,26): a made-up pile of 14 items · L10 (19,11): a dormant teleporter switched by a pad · L4: 24 teleporters · L2, L7: spinners · L5, L7: switched false walls · /: search (COIN, GEN, MONSTER, TROLIN) · click L10 on the bar for the level list · ?: controls help · SHOW hides kinds. Left-drag pans, the wheel zooms (no further out than the whole level).
URL parameters for screenshots: ?mode=now|new&L=4&cs=48&hh=x,y (level, cell size, hovered cell in level coordinates).
